name: Ryou
source:
Ryou is an orphan who gained his independence through his talent in programming. He holds some money-making contracts with businesses and even a bank. He deeply cares for his friends, Claire and Rina since they shared a strong adolescence with each other. He developed feelings for Claire. He is actually aware of Rina’s feelings for him.

All of this get complicated very quickly when rumors about monsters in the forest appear and the suggestion from Sophia that Claire and Rina may be hiding something dark from him. What will Ryou do?

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=47]MangaGamer[/url]]
